caseName: Capital Cities Cable, Inc. v. Crisp
caseNameFull: Capital Cities Cable, Inc. v. Crisp, Director, Oklahoma Alcoholic Beverage Control Board

opinions.text: C. A. 10th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 464 U. S. 818.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted. Motion of the Solicitor General to permit Michael W. McConnell, Esquire, to present oral argument pro hac vice on behalf of the Federal Communications Commission as amicus curiae granted.
